disclaimer: Training-simulation rules for fictional crew. Comparisons are explanations, not diagnoses or medical advice.
earth_based_label: Earth-based adult reference. Not validated for spaceflight.

personal_baseline_rules.note: Synthetic demo band of 15 bpm either side of the personal resting baseline. Not a clinical threshold.

reference_rules.note: Resting heart rate for adults and children 10 years and older. Well-trained athletes may rest at 40 to 60 bpm.

source.title: Pulse
source.publisher: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia, U.S. National Library of Medicine

reference_rules.note: Categories assume a seated, rested reading with an upper-arm cuff. Only a medical professional can confirm a diagnosis.
Laboratory fasting plasma glucose after at least 8 hours without caloric intake. These cutoffs are never applied to a handheld meter reading.

source.title: 2. Diagnosis and Classification of Diabetes: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2025

reference_rules.note: The source gives a typical range of 36.1 to 37.2 °C and fever above 38 °C without naming a site. The project applies it to oral readings only.

source.title: Body temperature norms
source.publisher: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia, U.S. National Library of Medicine

contextual_metrics.note: Sleep is shown as context for the other readings. It is not scored as normal or abnormal.
Mood is a project-defined self-report and is shown as context only. It is never turned into a mental-state score.
Symptoms are self-reported context, not a diagnosis. Private text stays in the Crew projection.
